title: Create comprehensive admin vendor and product management dashboard

requirements.text: Create a comprehensive vendor overview section in the admin dashboard displaying all vendors in a table or card layout with columns for vendor name, business address, total products count, orders assigned count, and quick enable/disable toggle button for each vendor

quotes: admin dash board where admin or team can view all the products entered by the all the vendors , vendors>products, address, orders assigned, enable and disable button

acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard displays all registered vendors
Each vendor row shows: business name, full address, total products count, assigned orders count
Enable/disable toggle button is present and functional for each vendor
Clicking enable/disable updates vendor status in real-time

requirements.text: Add a drill-down view in the admin dashboard that displays all products for a selected vendor, showing product name, description, price, quantity, SKU, status (enabled/disabled), and thumbnail images of uploaded photos

quotes: vendors>products> view all products ,product details , photo uploaded

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking on a vendor in the vendor overview opens a detailed products view
Products view displays all products created by that vendor
Each product shows: name, description, price in rupees, quantity, SKU, enabled/disabled status
Product photos are displayed as thumbnails or in a gallery format
View includes navigation back to vendor overview

requirements.text: Implement product editing functionality in the admin dashboard that allows admin to edit any product field (name, description, price, quantity, photos) and automatically syncs those changes so they are visible to the vendor who created the product

quotes: edit products (edited one should seen by the vendors)

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click an edit button on any product in the vendor products view
Edit form allows modification of product name, description, price, quantity
Admin can add or remove product photos during editing
After saving, changes are immediately reflected in the vendor's product list
Vendor sees the updated product information in their dashboard without manual refresh

requirements.text: Create backend function updateProductByAdmin in main.mo that accepts productId and updated product fields, validates admin authorization, updates the product in storage, and returns success confirmation

quotes: edit products (edited one should seen by the vendors)

acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts productId and all editable product fields as parameters
Function verifies caller is an admin or active team member
Function updates the product record in the Map storage
Function returns success/error response
Updated product is immediately available via getProduct and listVendorProducts queries

requirements.text: Add a React Query mutation hook useUpdateProductByAdmin in useQueries.ts that calls the backend updateProductByAdmin function and invalidates product-related queries to refresh the UI

quotes: edit products (edited one should seen by the vendors)

acceptanceCriteria: Hook accepts productId and updated product data as parameters
Hook calls the backend updateProductByAdmin function via actor
On success, invalidates 'products', 'vendorProducts', and 'allProducts' queries
Returns mutation status (loading, error, success) for UI feedback

requirements.text: Create a ProductEditDialog component in frontend that displays a form with all product fields pre-filled, allows admin to modify values and photos, and submits changes using the useUpdateProductByAdmin mutation hook

quotes: edit products (edited one should seen by the vendors)

acceptanceCriteria: Dialog opens with current product data pre-filled in form fields
Form includes fields for name, description, price, quantity
Photo management allows viewing current photos, removing photos, and uploading new ones
Submit button triggers useUpdateProductByAdmin mutation
Success shows confirmation toast and closes dialog
Error displays appropriate error message

constraints: Use the single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo for all new backend functions
Maintain existing ProductManagementAdmin.tsx component and extend it rather than replacing it
Preserve the existing Map-based storage pattern for products and vendors
Ensure admin authorization checks use the existing isAdmin or isTeamMember logic
Keep the existing photo upload and watermarking system intact
nonGoals: Creating new vendor or order management features beyond what already exists
Modifying the vendor dashboard or vendor-facing product editing interface
Changing the existing product data model structure
Implementing bulk product editing or multi-select operations
